page.overview:
Who is Basaku?

The Saiyan Berserker is a playable Saiyan avatar in Dragon Ball Heroes.

His appearance is similar to that of Gotenks, with his hairstyle the same as Raditz's and while possessing facial features strongly resembling Vegeta. In his original outfit, he wears yellow pants and a black waist cloak secured by a purple obi along with thin yellow arm bands, purple wristbands, and black boots with purple accents similar in style to those worn by Goku. He lets his tail hang freely in this outfit.

His Class-up outfit consists of black Battle Armor with brass yellow shoulder and crotch guards along with the armbands from his previous outfit, black armored fingerless gloves with white accents akin to those worn by Raditz and Nappa, tight black pants, a yellow waist cape, purple socks, and black armored boots with light gray accents. He wraps his tail around his waist in this outfit.

His Super Class-up outfit switches out his traditional armor for a black and dark gray armored jumpsuit with white lining and brass yellow guards on his shoulders and the outer sides of his thighs. His gloves from his previous outfit now have fingers, and his boots now have a brass yellow toe cap.
